topic: Investigate the effectiveness of GenAI tools in supporting mathematics achievement among middle school students (typically ages 11-14, grades 6-8). Prioritize original comparative studies published in English (academic journals or conference proceedings) that measure math learning outcomes—such as grades, standardized test scores, conceptual understanding, and problem-solving skills—of students who use a variety of GenAI tools versus those who do not. If direct comparative studies are lacking, summarize the best available empirical evidence (including pilot studies, implementation reports, and credible reviews) on how GenAI tools impact any aspect of math achievement in this age group. Where possible, link to official publications.
